snippet.title: Cyberpunk 2077: Ultimate Edition — Nintendo Switch™ 2 Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Cyberpunk 2077: Ultimate Edition is out now on Nintendo Switch 2! 

Become V, a cyber-enhanced mercenary determined to make their name in Night City — a megalopolis obsessed with power, glamor, and body modification. Take on high-stakes gigs and climb the ranks from a rising merc to a legendary cyberpunk. 

Experience that and more at home and on the go, taking full advantage of the unique features of Nintendo Switch 2 —  including motion and mouse controls, gyro aiming, and touch screen capabilities.

Buy now digitally or physically: https://www.cyberpunk.net/buy
